sources.title: GitHub - krea-ai/krea-2: Official inference code for Krea 2
sources.snippet: Krea 2 RAW is the base model. It's a pretrained checkpoint with no distillation, so it's diverse and highly malleable, and it's what you should use for fine-tuning, post-training, and LoRA training. Krea 2 Turbo is an 8-step distilled checkpoint built for fast, high-quality text-to-image. The two models are designed to work together.
